probes.name: synthetic real Redis K2
probes.observed: Dedicated redis:8 (8.10.1, Search/JSON/TimeSeries) on 127.0.0.1:6390, AOF everysec, noeviction, 1 GiB maxmemory: 18 of 18 predeclared checks held at 20000 items x 384 dims. Append+WAITAOF ack p95 1010 ms (400 writes, 0 unconfirmed), projection p95 14 ms, logical 203 MB, physical peak 265 MB, disk 131 MB, restart usable in 1.7 s with acknowledged writes intact, noeviction refused with no eviction, logical purge 1 ms, physical erasure of the purged payload 1.35 s.
probes.attempt_note: Attempt 1 ended ERROR after 27 min: the runner did not parse RESP3 FT.SEARCH/FT.INFO maps and its wait helper hid the error. A runner defect, fixed and retained, not a Redis observation.
caveats: persistence.aof_rewrite_seconds (0.001) measures the wait remaining after 50 acknowledged writes, not the rewrite's own duration; no check depends on it.
observations.protocol reads null although replies were RESP3 maps (the client default).
With appendfsync everysec a confirmed save costs about one second; M3's notice latency should assume it.
probes.scope: Synthetic, single instance; topology provisional. The shared optimus-redis was never contacted.
